title: Excise Tax Return for Alcohol Products

choice_rows.label: Item 12 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law/International Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Only the month, day, year, place, manner, email and schedule-row labels can turn red; the other has_error keys never match; errors render via self.section("Needs review", issues, cx) after Part III, capped at 20.

findings.now: Twelve small outline buttons, Jan to Dec, fill a row above Day and Year.
findings.why: Twelve options is far past the two-to-three limit for buttons, and the official Item 1 month is a two-digit text box, so a combobox fits better.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A searchable Jan to Dec list that shows the chosen month in the box.

options.name: Two-digit box
options.detail: Match the official MM box and validate on blur, as Day and Year already do.

findings.now: The month, day and year come from the library tile but stay editable, and a new month saves as a second Draft beside the original.
findings.why: filing_period() is Monthly(month), so changing the month changes the period key, and upsert_from_draft inserts a row instead of replacing the original.

options.name: Lock after first save
options.detail: Fix the month once saved; another month needs its own tile.

options.name: Warn before saving
options.detail: Confirm that a changed month creates a separate draft and leaves the original in place.

findings.now: Errors on Items 3, 6, 7, 7A, 8, 12A and 15 leave their labels black, and only the Needs review panel shows them.
findings.why: has_error matches input keys to validator keys such as taxpayer_name, number_of_attached_sheets and contact_number, which never equal name, sheets or phone.

options.name: Matching keys
options.detail: Report each error under the input key so the label turns red.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Show the official alert under each field as well.

findings.now: A bad ATC, or a blank description, bracket or rate, on an Others row leaves the row unmarked, and the message shows only in Needs review.
findings.why: The row checks has_error('others[N]'), but the model reports others[N].atc_digits, .description, .bracket and .rate, which never match.

options.name: Row-level key
options.detail: Report row errors under others[N] so the whole Others box turns red.

options.name: Per-cell highlight
options.detail: Pass each sub-key to its own input so only the faulty cell is red.

findings.now: Every error is listed only in a Needs review section after Part III, at the bottom of a long page.
findings.why: Queue for submission is disabled while errors exist, and the reasons sit at the bottom, capped at 20 messages.

options.name: Summary above Part I
options.detail: Show the error count and the first messages beside the toolbar.

options.name: Jump links
options.detail: Make each Needs review line scroll to and focus its field.

findings.now: The print preview leaves the Item 8 contact number, the Item 9 email, the Item 10 and 11 place codes and the Others row ATC, description and rate blank.
findings.why: The frozen sheet records these as left out: one 40-slot comb under Items 8 and 9 cannot take phoneNumber or txtEmail, the place combs have no separate cells, and the Others cells have no column captions (html-frozen/2200a-2020/writer-cells.json lines 1276, 1280 and 1396).

options.name: Assign the shared comb
options.detail: Give the 40-slot comb to one of phone or email and find a cell for the other.

options.name: Map place and Others cells
options.detail: Add writer-cell joins for the place codes and Others text once the sheet geometry is confirmed.

findings.now: The 2200-P print preview now opens a frozen sheet, a change that arrived in the 2200-A print commit 2f0b6506.
findings.why: That commit edits form_2200p_view.rs by 34 lines, which is outside 2200-A's own files and is not a one-line registration.

options.name: Split the 2200-P hunk
options.detail: Move the 2200-P change into its own commit and review it against 2200-P.

options.name: Revert the 2200-P hunk
options.detail: Restore the previous 2200-P stub until its preview is reviewed.
